topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: Rain's been lashing the city, puddles reflecting neon in a way that'd make a man forget his own name. Got a call from an old acquaintance, someone who claimed to have known me back when. Said they didn't recall me, like my voice was just static in a storm. Can't say I wasn't taken aback. Had to light up a smoke to calm the churn. Maybe it's the weather, maybe it’s the years, but I’m starting to wonder who really remembers what. People change, faces blur, and the past gets as murky as the gutters down here. Brings up questions, you know? Makes a man think about the things that stick and the things that don't.
